cache.value: {"value":"{\"data\":\"{\\\"response_message\\\":\\\"BCeID (BC Electronic Identity) is a secure online authentication service provided by the Government of British Columbia.\\\\n\\\\nIt lets individuals, businesses, and organizations access many provincial government online services using a single username and password, instead of separate logins for each service.\\\\n\\\\nFor the water permit application system:\\\\n- “Apply with BCeID” means you sign in using your BCeID before starting or continuing your application, so you can save your progress and return later.\\\\n- You can apply without BCeID, but if you leave the application before submitting, your information will be lost and you cannot resume later.\\\\n\\\\nMore details and registration are available at: https://www.bceid.ca/\\\",\\\"step_number\\\":\\\"\\\"}\",\"status\":200,\"statusText\":\"OK\",\"headers\":{\"content-length\":\"764\",\"content-type\":\"application/json\",\"date\":\"Fri, 16 Oct 2026 19:38:08 GMT\",\"server\":\"uvicorn\"},\"latencyMs\":11575}","expires":1793389100595}
